raw_segments.text: Florizal. By his command have I here touched Cecilia, and from him give you all greetings
that a king at friend can send his brother. And but infirmity which waits upon worn times
hath something seized his wished ability. He had himself the lands and waters, twixt
your throne and his measured to look upon you. Whom he loves, he bade me say so, more
than all the scepters and those that bear them living."
